rationale: Recurring noun on this page (lines 9, 16, 22) in series with ⲧⲃⲁⲕⲉ 'bitterness' and ⲧⲁⲩⲡⲏ (λύπη). Likely Lycopolitan reflex of ⲡⲕⲏ/ⲡⲱϣ-ⲛϩⲏⲧ 'distress, lamentation.' Captures the affective pole between bitterness (somatic) and lupē (Greek-philosophical).

Hapax in this corpus. Stands in triadic series with ⲱⲧⲁⲣⲧⲣ̄ 'disturbance' and ⲧⲁⲣⲁⲭⲏ as denial-list of agitations the New Man does not undergo. Possibly Lyc reflex of ⲧⲱϩⲥ̄ 'strike, smite' nominalized = 'a striking, perturbation.' Confidence low.
Greek loanword ἀπαντάω 'meet, encounter' as Coptic verb with ⲣ̄- prefix. Used here cosmologically of the heavenly powers' encounter with the soul during moments of stillness.
Lyc form of ⲛⲉϩⲥⲉ 'wake, arise.' Used here transitively with ⲁⲣⲁ⸗ 'upon him' = 'arise upon, befall.' Cf. accumulated ⲁⲛⲉϩⲥⲉ 'awake.'
Causative reduplicated form of ⲱⲧⲁⲣⲧⲣ̄ 'be disturbed' — i.e., 'cause-disturbance.' The heavenly powers actively disturb the body when they themselves are agitated.
Lyc reflex of ⲟⲉⲓⲕ 'bread.' In line 17 ⲧⲧⲣⲟⲫⲏ ⲙ̄ⲡⲁⲓⲕ 'the food of bread' = the bread-food.
